preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of edges m is between 0 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v and 0 <= t <= 10**18 for u, v, t in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the valid range and has a non-negative integer weight up to 10^18.
The number of parsed edges matches m.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == (sum(s for u, v, s in interesting_triples) % (10**9 + 7))
postconditions.description: The output is the sum of all s values from interesting triples (u, v, s) modulo 10^9 + 7, where a triple is interesting if 1 <= u < v <= n and there exists a path between u and v with edge XOR sum equal to s.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= u < v <= n and exists_path_xor(u, v, s) for u, v, s in interesting_triples)
postconditions.description: Every triple in the set of interesting triples satisfies the condition that u < v and there exists a path between u and v with XOR sum s.

postconditions.expression: all(not exists_path_xor(u, v, s) or (u, v, s) in interesting_triples for u in range(1, n+1) for v in range(u+1, n+1) for s in possible_xor_values(u, v))
postconditions.description: The set of interesting triples is complete; it contains every valid (u, v, s) where a path with XOR sum s exists between u and v.
